programs.desc: Dr. Amy Larsen, former chief of internal medicine, is rebuilding her life after a tragic accident that left her with no memory.Now she is an intern.Her past still haunts me.

programs.title: Berlin Nobody
programs.desc: American social psychologist Ben Monroe (Eric Bana) moves to Berlin after breaking up with his wife.He gained fame for his research on sects, including a religious group operating in the German capital, and is currently preparing to write another book on this subject.One day, his partner Nina (Sylvia Hoeks) and his old friend, policeman Max Aumann (Stephan Kampwirth), take him to a crime scene where it seems that several people have been ritually committed suicide.Soon, Ben is visited by his 16-year-old daughter, Mazzy (Sadie Sink).She is seduced by a local boy, Martin (Jonas Dassler).He tells her that he is involved in the activities of a pro-ecological non-governmental organization run by the charismatic Hilma (Sophie Rois).The girl allows herself to be drawn into this group, unaware that it is a sect that has chosen her as a victim.When Ben discovers how much danger Mazzy is in, he races against time to save her.The film's script is based on the 2015 novel by Nicholas Hogg."Tokyo", but the setting was moved to Berlin.

programs.title: Zombieland: Double Tap
programs.desc: Ten years have passed since Tallahassee (Woody Harrelson), Columbus (Jesse Eisenberg), Wichita (Emma Stone) and Little Rock (Abigail Breslin) decided to face a world full of the living dead together.It seemed that they knew everything about zombies and knew how to deal with them.Over time, however, bloodthirsty creatures managed to evolve and spread throughout the country.Four heroes must face a new threat.The problems are mounting, and there are typical family conflicts between them.On their way, they also meet other survivors.Sequel to "Zombieland" from 2009.This is another collaboration between Jesse Eisenberg and Woody Harrelson - they met, among others,on the set of two parts of "Illusion".A mixture of chocolate and coffee was used to create realistic-looking blood - the main actors agreed that it tasted like chemicals and they would not like to play zombie characters who had this fake blood in their mouths and on their teeth.

programs.title: Babygirl
programs.desc: Romy (Nicole Kidman) leads a stable and prosperous life.She manages a modern, dynamically developing company, lives in a comfortable house with her devoted husband Jacob (Antonio Banderas) and two teenage daughters.Her everyday life changes when a young intern, Samuel (Harris Dickinson), appears.Despite the age difference, Romy and Samuel begin a fiery romance.The woman begins to rediscover herself, although this decision may mean the loss of both her professional position and her family.She is faced with the decision of whether to follow her own desires, risking everything she has achieved so far.

programs.title: Georgie \u0026 Mandy'S First Marriage 2
programs.desc: Young married couple Georgie and Mandy are raising their daughter, learning everyday life in their new role as parents.Each day brings new challenges and fatigue that puts their relationship to the test.

programs.title: The Outrun
programs.desc: A young woman named Rona (Saoirse Ronan), who has recently left an addiction treatment center, returns from London to her native Scotland, to one of the islands of the Orkney archipelago.Because her parents are separated, she lives alternately with her mother, where she meets with her religious friends, and with her father, whom she helps on the farm.At the same time, she is still trying to cope with difficult memories - the beginning of her stay in London, where she started studying biology and often went to clubs with her boyfriend Daynin (Paapa Essiedu).She didn't even notice when she fell into alcoholism, which led to problems in her relationship and began to destroy her life.Meanwhile, while staying on the island, Rona decides to return to London.However, already on the ferry he feels that he is unable to control the urge to drink alcohol.He must re-plan his life.

programs.title: Frieda's Case
programs.desc: The year 1904. A seamstress accused of a crime becomes the center of a trial that exposes the injustices of the legal system.

programs.title: Little women
programs.desc: The times of the Civil War.In the absence of their father, who is serving in the military away from the family, the four March sisters from Orchard House are cared for by their mother alone.Marmee wants them to find their own path and helps them enter adulthood.Each of them has a different personality.The oldest Meg dreams of becoming an actress.Family-oriented and warm, Beth has a talent for playing the piano.Jo, an aspiring writer, pursues her goal with her characteristic energy and tenacity.Amy, a bit smart, wants to become a painter.Despite their own problems, the girls are not indifferent to other people's suffering.Young women will get to know the taste of first loves and disappointments.Fate subjects them to tests, after which their lives will never be the same again.

programs.title: L'amica geniale 2
programs.desc:
Sixteen-year-olds Lila (Gaia Girace) and Elena (Margherita Mazzucco) are bored with the monotony of everyday life.Lila has just gotten married, but the wedding has made her feel like she's lost herself.Elena is doing great at school, but her friend's wedding helped her understand something.She discovered that she didn't feel happy among her friends.The girls spend their holidays in Ischia.Once there, they run into their old friend from the neighborhood, Nino Sarratore (Francesco Serpico).The man is studying and it seems that a great future awaits him.Unexpectedly, this meeting has a negative impact on Lila and Elena's friendship.Their relationship is loosening.One day, Lila comes up with an idea and opens an exclusive shoe salon in Naples.The store belongs to the Solar family.Meanwhile, Elena is committed to her studies.She manages to get into the University of Pisa.Adaptation of the second part of the novel series by Elena Ferrante
An advertisement with Lili's photo is mounted above the window of a new shoe showroom in the center of Naples.At the same time, the woman starts working in the Carracci family grocery store.He is excellent behind the counter, using his charm, charisma and intelligence.Her husband begins to cooperate more closely with the Solara brothers, which causes the woman's increasing reluctance and becomes the cause of further quarrels.One evening, Lila goes with Elena to a party held at Professor Galiani's house.Once there, the friends realize that each of them now lives in a different world.

programs.title: Challengers
programs.desc: Tennis player Tashi Duncan (Zendaya) has had impressive success on the court in the past.Her career was ended by an injury.Today, the woman is the trainer of Art Donaldson (Mike Faist) - her partner and father of her daughter.The man is one title short of the Grand Slam, but he is struggling with injury and age, which may ruin the pair's ambitions.After a series of defeats, the player plans to take part in the Challenger tournament in New Rochelle, New York, which is to be his warm-up before the US Open and a chance to regain his form.Unexpectedly, in the finale, Art will have to face Patrick Zweig (Josh O'Connor) - his childhood friend and Tashi's ex-boyfriend.The match becomes an opportunity for all three to confront their turbulent past.The film by Italian director Luca Guadagnino, the creator of the Oscar-nominated "Those Days, Those Nights", is a combination of a sports drama and a story about a love triangle.

programs.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
programs.desc: Spider Man's identity is revealed.The whole world learns that Peter Parker (Tom Holland) is hiding under the mask.From then on everything changes.The boy cannot perform his superhero duties as before.Worse still, he puts those he cares about most in danger, including his girlfriend, MJ (Zendaya), and his best friend, Ned Leeds (Jacob Batalon).Finally, desperate Peter decides to ask Dr. Strange (Benedict Cumberbatch) for help.Unfortunately, a misused spell causes the most powerful villains to be unleashed.Spider-Man once again has to face Norman Osborn (Will Dafoe), who took the form of the Green Goblin, and Doctor Octopus (Alfred Molina).
